item.title: Trump’s racist post about Obamas is deleted after backlash despite White House earlier defending it
item.description: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump’s racist social media post featuring former President Barack Obama and his wife, Michelle Obama, as primates in a jungle was deleted Friday after a backlash from both Republicans and Democrats who criticized the video as offensive.

item.title: LEGISLATIVE ROUNDUP: Attorney General Sunday warns of potential property ownership scams
item.description: Attorney General Dave Sunday this week is warning Pennsylvanians of scams relating to homeownership, involving the false or forged transfers of a property deed or title.

item.title: US stocks soar to their best day since May as the Dow tops 50,000 and bitcoin stops plunging
item.description: NEW YORK — The U.S. stock market roared back on Friday, as technology stocks recovered much of their losses from earlier in the week and bitcoin halted its plunge, at least for now.

item.title: How the Patriots will win: Vrabel’s leadership, underrated offense
item.description: SANTA CLARA, Calif. — As the New England Patriots continued to rack up wins late in the regular season, coach Mike Vrabel shied away from mentioning the idea of a Super Bowl run when he spoke to his team after games.

item.title: How will the Seahawks win: Top NFL receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba
item.description: SAN FRANCISCO — Jaxon Smith-Njigba appeared as though he would have his work cut out for him to replicate the success he enjoyed in his first 1,000-yard season in 2024.

item.title: Local roundup: Wilkes wrestling continues dual streak with win over King’s
item.description: Wilkes opened Friday’s dual meet with three wins and closed it out with four more to earn a 25-13 victory over rival King’s.

item.title: Dumba scores hat trick as WBS Penguins outlast Phantoms
item.description: Matt Dumba spearheaded the Wilkes-Barre/Scranton Penguins’ 6-5 victory over the Lehigh Valley Phantoms on Friday night in Allentown.

item.title: Milan Cortina Olympics officially open with a multi-site ceremony
item.description: MILAN — Featuring tributes to da Vinci and Dante, Puccini and Pausini, Armani and Fellini, pasta and vino, and other iconic tastes of Italian culture — plus Mariah Carey hitting all the high notes in “Nel Blu Dipinto Di Blu” aka “Volare” — an unprecedented four-site, dual-cauldron opening ceremony got the Milan Cortina Olympics officially started Friday.

item.title: US applications for jobless benefits jump by 22,000 to 231,000 last week, the most in 2 months
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — The number of Americans applying for unemployment benefits jumped last week but remains in the same historically low range of the past few years.
